scenes.a: If you woke up anxious about having enough strength for today, take heart.
Psalm 23 verse 1 declares, The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.
You do not have to carry tomorrow's burdens or strive in your own power this morning.
The Heavenly Father knows your every need before you even speak it.
He walks beside you into this day, ordering your steps and providing what you need.
Rest your anxious mind in His loving care right now.
He is faithful to sustain you through every single hour.
Subscribe to The Morning Altar to begin every sunrise in prayer.
